# ReqogniLoom — MCP client integration

One client, one page, **German and English**. Every page is generated from `clients/registry.yaml`; manual edits are a CI failure.

## Matrix

| Client | Transport | Auth | Target | Page |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | SSE | `X-API-Key` | L3 | [Claude Code](claude-code.md) |
| Codex CLI | Streamable HTTP | `Authorization: Bearer` | L3 | [Codex CLI](codex.md) |
| OpenCode | SSE | `X-API-Key` | L3 | [OpenCode](opencode.md) |
| Kimi Code | Streamable HTTP | `Authorization: Bearer` | L2 | [Kimi Code](kimi-code.md) |
| Antigravity | SSE | `X-API-Key` | L3 | [Antigravity](antigravity.md) |
| Hermes | stdio bridge | `X-API-Key` | L3 | [Hermes](hermes.md) |

## Conventions

- MCP-URL: `${REQOGNILOOM_MCP_URL}`
- API key: `${REQOGNILOOM_API_KEY}` (prefix `reqlo_`)
- Auth-Header (Standard): `X-API-Key` — **exception Codex: Bearer**.

### Transport decision

- **Streamable HTTP** (`/mcp/`): client speaks it natively — preferred.
- **SSE** (`/mcp/sse/`): plugin/store path expects SSE (Claude plugin, Antigravity).
- **stdio bridge** (local script): stdio-only client (OpenCode `local`, Hermes).

## Unified smoke test

- **Task:** Use the reqogniloom MCP tool and report the number of requirements in workspace <workspace-id>.
- **Second query:** List the workspaces.
- **Pass:** Pass when both numbers match the REST cross-check AND the MCP call is visible in the client log.
